season.evidence: Stored Apr-Sep. Search: a guide lists late summer/fall as the snow-free window and late spring to mid-July as the snow-travel window; resort closes early May. Histogram: May 120, Jun 71, Jul 30. Oct tolerated.

track.why: Our catalog has exactly one route on the peak; the July 18 2026 track starts and ends at the Alpental lot (78/81 m from pin), summit within 6 m, 7.1 mi round trip, 2,544 ft gain, up the ski-run line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Also complete, but starts 242 m from pin and visits the South Peak first.
May 2015 Under the Chair lifts; end 1.7 km from pin so not a complete round trip.

facts.text: In July and August the lower slopes grow dense leafy brush; the cleared service road beside the Sessel lift avoids the worst of it.
On a summer weekend the Alpental lot can be full by mid-morning; arrive early.
The summit block is a short scramble, and a small chimney gives access.
In early October the steep dirt and brush are slick when damp and the bootpath is easy to lose; carry a GPS track.

notes: Three July 18 2026 tracks exist; 3272181 chosen as the most complete.
